contentBlocks.body: ReadonlyArray tells callers that your function will read a list without changing it. It is a small annotation that prevents accidental mutation in shared state.

payload.text: Use ____<number> when a function should read scores without mutating the input list.

knowledgeItems.prompt: Return passing scores from a readonly input without changing the original array.
Which call is a compile error on scores: ReadonlyArray<number>?

payload.explanation: ReadonlyArray has no mutating methods such as push, pop, splice, or sort; non-mutating ones like filter and map are fine.
